responsibility: This is the main implementation file for the M32C GCC backend, providing the target hook definitions and core logic that tie the port together. It owns register-class and addressing validation, argument passing and return conventions, prologue/epilogue and interrupt handling, pragma-address tracking, compare optimization and assembly emission, move/reload/shift helpers, section and attribute handling, and initialization of the final targetm structure for the R8C/M16C/M32C family.
same_name_distinction: Implementation companion to the other m32c files: this C++ source provides the executable target-hook bodies and helper routines that the header binds via macros, and it consumes option state from m32c.opt plus machine-description constructs from the .md files to drive code generation.
